Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the genealogical data presented in the search results. In Step 1, the search results from GenoPro explicitly stated: "His paternal grandparents were Prince Frederik The 2. of House Hesse-Kassel and Princess Mary of House Hanover." Despite this clear statement identifying Princess Mary of Hanover as the paternal grandmother, the agent's subsequent analysis (in Step 2) incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandmother was Louise of Denmark and Norway. This error stemmed from a failure to properly parse the specific text in the search snippet and instead relying on a different, unrelated lineage (that of Prince Frederick William, born 1820) which appeared in later search results. The agent confused the father of Prince William (Frederick, born 1771) with a different Prince Frederick (born 1820), leading to the identification of the wrong grandmother.
